Database ERD

erDiagram
    Post {
        int id PK
    }
    Tag {
        int id PK
    }
    PostTag {
        int post_id PK,FK
        int tag_id PK,FK
    }
    LinkPreview {
        int id PK
        str url
        str title
    }
    Project {
        int id PK
    }
    User {
        int id PK
    }
    Role {
        int id PK
    }
    ProjectMembership {
        int project_id PK,FK
        int user_id PK,FK
        int role_id PK,FK
    }
    Post ||--o{ PostTag : "post_id"
    PostTag }o--|| Tag : "tag_id"
    Project ||--o{ ProjectMembership : "project_id"
    User ||--o{ ProjectMembership : "user_id"
    Role ||--o{ ProjectMembership : "role_id"
